nodes.name: keeper serves Felix ale
nodes.description: The tavern keeper approaches Felix, confirms his usual order, and sets a mug of ale before him.
evidence:
TAVERN KEEPER
Master Adler. Your usual ale?
The keeper sets a large mug of ale before Felix.
The TAVERN KEEPER approaches Felix.

FELIX
(absently, distracted)
Yes. Thank you.

nodes.name: Felix reveals nervous distraction
nodes.description: Felix drinks absently and fidgets with the gold ring on his left hand, signaling his anxiety.
evidence: Felix drinks without noticing.
Felix turns the GOLD RING on his LEFT HAND as he speaks, sliding it back and forth across his knuckle -- a nervous habit.

nodes.name: Holt reports no dealer contact
nodes.description: Holt states that no dealer in the district has yet been approached about a Northern Reaches survey.
evidence:
HOLT
No dealer in the district has been approached about a Northern Reaches survey. Not yet.

nodes.name: Felix explains survey timeline
nodes.description: Felix says a work of that scale would be moved slowly and require at least two years from survey to final draft.
evidence:
FELIX
They will wait. A piece like this -- two years of work from initial survey to final draft -- you do not move it quickly.

FELIX
Ask any cartographer of standing. That scope, that level of survey correction -- two years is the minimum.

nodes.name: Holt records Felix's statement
nodes.description: Holt makes a note after Felix describes the survey's timeline and significance.
evidence: Holt makes a note.

nodes.name: Felix confides regret to Sable
nodes.description: While Holt is away, Felix quietly tells Sable he wishes he had been more careful and claims he learned of the threat only after the chest was empty.
evidence:
FELIX (CONT'D)
(low, to Sable)
I wish I had been more careful. No one warned me there was any specific threat. I had no idea any of this was coming until the chest was already empty.
Holt steps away to speak quietly with a constable at the door. Felix leans toward Sable.

nodes.name: Sable withholds response
nodes.description: Sable remains silent and looks down at the table instead of answering Felix's confession.
evidence: Sable says nothing. She looks down at the table.

nodes.name: Holt cites hidden chest notes
nodes.description: After returning, Holt says his deputy's notes place the stolen chest behind the bookcase in the main room on the morning of the theft.
evidence:
HOLT
One more thing. My deputy's notes from the morning of the theft say the chest was hidden behind the bookcase in the main room.
Holt returns.

nodes.name: Felix equivocates about chest location
nodes.description: Felix hesitantly acknowledges the chest was behind the bookcase, sounding uncertain about the detail.
evidence:
FELIX
Behind the bookcase. Yes. I suppose that is where it was.

nodes.name: Holt promises record correction
nodes.description: Holt states that he will correct the official record regarding the chest's location regardless of Felix's uncertainty.
evidence:
HOLT
I will have the record corrected regardless.
